add.name: the Standing Legion
add.look: A whole army, dead since before the Transition, still holding the line it was ordered to hold. Four thousand of them across a valley floor, shields up, facing an enemy that stopped existing centuries ago. They do not rot. They do not move until something crosses the line.
add.danger: Anything that crosses the line is the enemy. They answer as an army answers — in ranks, in volleys, by the thousand — and they do not tire, break or rout. A road that runs through their valley is closed.
pressures: KNOW (find the order they are still obeying)
SHAPE (give them a true ending to the war)
add.clean: Not four thousand people — one order, still running in four thousand bodies. There is no one in there to grieve. Ending it is telling the war it is over.
add._why: A legendary that a strong party cannot simply fight: the answer is to read the order and end it. The class's own concept (a body still doing the last thing it was told) scaled to an army.

add.name: the Ninefold Foundry
add.look: A pre-Transition foundry the size of a town, woken and walking on legs it built for itself out of its own furnaces. It is still making things. It has been making them for a very long time, and none of them are for anyone.
add.danger: It takes whatever it walks over as stock — stone, iron, a hold's walls, the people inside — and it makes something out of it. What it makes then works for it, until it is taken apart for stock in turn.
pressures: KNOW (read what it thinks it is building)
SHAPE (finish the project, so it stops)
add.clean: A tool with no hand left to hold it, following an order that no longer means anything. Stopping it is repair by other means.
add._why: The feral_construct class at legendary scale. The Gearfather (heroic) is its small cousin, so the class climbs the ladder.

add.name: the Eye of the Storm
add.look: Where the Manifestation Storm is thickest, the air thinks. It is not a creature. It is a place that dreams creatures, a sky that keeps almost-becoming something and then does, briefly, before it forgets.
add.danger: Whatever it dreams walks out of it. Its thoughts become weather, and its weather becomes things with teeth. Standing inside it is standing inside a mind that does not know you are there, and it may think you into something else.
pressures: KNOW (read a thought the size of a sky)
add.clean: No one is there to kill. It is the Storm's own centre — ending it is calming weather, and the grief is for everything it could have made.
add._why: Mythic, and unique in the world: the Storm arc's own heart, met as an ending rather than a roll on a road. The world's biggest version of the Unmoored Choir (epic).

add.name: the First Root
add.look: A forest that is one living thing, the size of a region. Every tree in it is the same tree. Its roots run under three traditions' lands, and it has been growing, very slowly, toward something no one has understood.
add.danger: It does not attack. It grows. A hold on its edge wakes one morning inside it, and the road home has become a root. The things that live inside it are its hands, and it has a great many hands.
pressures: KNOW (find what it is growing toward)
WARD (keep a place from being taken in)
MOVE (find a way through a forest that moves)
UNMAKE (at a cost to the land itself)
add.clean: A growth, not a grievance. It wants nothing but to grow. Stopping it is the Green Schism's hardest question: what is taken from the living world to keep the human one.
add._why: Mythic, unique, and tied to the Green Schism, so ending it is an arc choice rather than a kill. The Bloom That Hungers (heroic) is its seed.
